workload.name: continuous motion
workload.generator: ffplay renders FFmpeg lavfi testsrc2 at native 1824x848 and 60 Hz in a fullscreen Wayland window. The browser only observes and decodes that native application.
workload.command: ffplay -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=1824x848:rate=60 -fs -autoexit (fixed owned process; no caller-supplied command)

topologyAtStart.ffmpegCommand: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel warning -nostdin -f rawvideo -pixel_format bgra -video_size 1824x848 -framerate 60 -re -i pipe:0 -an -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -tune zerolatency -profile:v baseline -level:v 5.2 -pix_fmt yuv420p -b:v 8000k -maxrate 16000k -bufsize 16000k -g 60 -keyint_min 60 -sc_threshold 0 -bf 0 -x264-params aud=1:repeat-headers=1 -vf scale=1824:848 -payload_type 96 -ssrc 2 -rtpflags skip_rtcp -f rtp rtp://127.0.0.1:59415?pkt_size=60000
